# KagiCyber rule base 2026.11 (generated, do not edit)

Same IDs, weights and legal bases as the CLI. Weight in brackets. Apply the EU checklist to EU-facing sites, each national module for every detected jurisdiction (high or medium confidence) and each site-type checklist that fits. Rules that fold into a core check are not separate rows. Max penalty per row: the national line below, otherwise the area table in SKILL.md.

## EU extended checklist

- EU-A1a [2] Operator legal name and legal form shown. Directive 2000/31/EC art. 5(1)(a)
- EU-A1f [1] Telephone number for consumers. Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6(1)(c) (only shop)
- EU-A2b [2] Privacy notice: recipients and international transfers. GDPR art. 13(1)(e),(f)
- EU-A2e [1] Privacy notice: DPO contact and automated decisions. GDPR art. 13(1)(b), 13(2)(f)
- EU-A2f [2] Privacy notice in the site language. GDPR art. 12(1)

- EU-A3g [1] Google Consent Mode is not used as a substitute for consent. EDPB Guidelines 2/2023 on art. 5(3)

- EU-A5 [1] E-mail marketing: opt-in, sender identified, unsubscribe in every message. Directive 2002/58/EC art. 13 (N/A unless mentioned on the site; MANUAL)
- EU-A8a [2] Rankings: main parameters disclosed. Directive 2005/29/EC art. 7(4a) (Omnibus) (N/A unless mentioned on the site)

## Online shop checklist (withdrawal, Omnibus, GPSR, EAA) (type:shop)

- SHOP-02 [3] 14-day right of withdrawal explained. Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6(1)(h), art. 9 (only shop)
- SHOP-03 [2] Model withdrawal form provided. Directive 2011/83/EU Annex I(B) (only shop)
- SHOP-04 [3] Online withdrawal function ("withdraw from contract here"). Directive (EU) 2023/2673, new CRD art. 11a - applies from 19 Jun 2026 (only shop)
- SHOP-05 [3] Price reductions show the lowest price of the last 30 days. Directive 98/6/EC art. 6a (Omnibus) (only shop; N/A unless mentioned on the site)
- SHOP-06 [2] Reviews: statement on whether and how they are verified. Directive 2005/29/EC art. 7(6) (Omnibus) (N/A unless mentioned on the site)
- SHOP-07 [2] Delivery costs and payment methods stated. Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6(1)(e),(g); art. 8(3) (only shop)
- SHOP-08 [2] Complaints and legal guarantee explained. Directive (EU) 2019/771 art. 10; Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6(1)(l) (only shop)
- SHOP-09 [1] No dead link to the EU ODR platform. Regulation (EU) 2024/3228 repealing the ODR Regulation (platform closed 20 Jul 2025) (only shop)
- SHOP-10 [2] Accessibility information for e-commerce (EAA). Directive (EU) 2019/882 art. 13, Annex V - from 28 Jun 2025 (only shop)
- SHOP-11 [3] Order button states the obligation to pay. Directive 2011/83/EU art. 8(2) (only shop; MANUAL)
- SHOP-12 [2] GPSR product information online. Regulation (EU) 2023/988 art. 19 - from 13 Dec 2024 (only shop; MANUAL)
- SHOP-13 [2] Prices include taxes. Directive 98/6/EC; Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6(1)(e) (only shop)
- SHOP-14 [2] Subscriptions: renewal terms and easy cancellation. Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6; Directive 2005/29/EC (only shop/saas; N/A unless mentioned on the site; MANUAL)
- Folded into core rows (add to their legal basis): C-11: Directive 2011/83/EU art. 6, art. 8(2)

## SaaS and platform checklist (DSA, account deletion, Data Act) (type:saas)

- SAAS-01 [2] DSA point of contact for users and authorities. Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (DSA) art. 11-12 (only saas)
- SAAS-02 [2] Notice-and-action channel for illegal content. DSA art. 16 (only saas; N/A unless mentioned on the site)
- SAAS-03 [2] How to delete an account is explained. GDPR art. 17 (only saas)
- SAAS-04 [1] Minimum age / parental consent addressed. GDPR art. 8 (only saas)
- SAAS-05 [1] Data export / switching information. Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 (Data Act) art. 23-26 - from 12 Sep 2025 (only saas)
- SAAS-06 [1] Changes to the digital service notified with a right to terminate. Directive (EU) 2019/770 art. 19 (only saas; MANUAL)

## Fintech checklist (licence, credit ads, MiCA, ADR) (type:fintech)

- FIN-01 [3] Licence / authorisation and regulator shown. PSD2 art. 13; CRD; MiFID II; MiCA art. 59; national law (only fintech)
- FIN-02 [2] Register number or link to the public register. National registers (e.g. KNF, FCA FS Register) (only fintech)
- FIN-03 [3] Credit ads include a representative example. Directive 2008/48/EC art. 4; Directive (EU) 2023/2225 art. 8 - from 20 Nov 2026 (N/A unless mentioned on the site)
- FIN-04 [2] Credit warning ("Borrowing money costs money"). Directive (EU) 2023/2225 art. 8(4) - from 20 Nov 2026 (N/A unless mentioned on the site; verify)
- FIN-05 [1] Outbound offer links carry no foreign ad-click identifiers. Directive 2005/29/EC art. 6 (transparency of commercial links)
- FIN-06 [3] CFD risk warning with the loss percentage. ESMA product intervention; MiFID II art. 24 (only fintech; N/A unless mentioned on the site)
- FIN-07 [2] Crypto: MiCA white paper and marketing labels. Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (MiCA) art. 7, 29, 53 (only fintech; N/A unless mentioned on the site)
- FIN-08 [2] Complaint procedure and financial ADR. PSD2 art. 101; Directive 2013/11/EU (only fintech)
- FIN-09 [1] AML/KYC processing described in the privacy notice. Directive (EU) 2015/849; GDPR art. 13 (only fintech)
- FIN-10 [2] Distance financial services: 14-day withdrawal information. Directive (EU) 2023/2673 (new CRD chapter III a) - from 19 Jun 2026 (only fintech; MANUAL)
